text.tspan: 1:28 PM new traffic peak; an Istio sidecar in Central US
hits its concurrency limit and doesn't scale up
automated monitoring: elevated errors, incident opened (1:40 PM post);
network flows on 4 HAProxy nodes carrying the
optimistic gateway retries + a latent VS Code retry bug:
shift some traffic to Northern Virginia, reduce gateway retries,
stop HAProxy on the saturated nodes at the same time,
block retry-triggering requests. 4:36 PM most services back
refuse Copilot token requests on purpose (403 at the LBs);
ramp traffic back site by site; 9:02 PM Copilot Token Service
recovered; 9:15 PM resolved after sustained healthy telemetry
